title: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner and Other Poems

vibeProfile.oneLine: A sailor cursed for killing an albatross, in Coleridge's haunted ballad.

summary: Coleridge's spellbinding ballad of a sailor cursed for killing an albatross, doomed to drift on a ghostly sea and to tell his tale forever, is one of the strangest and most haunting poems in English, gathered here with other work including the opium-dream fragment 'Kubla Khan'. Dreamlike, musical and shot through with guilt and wonder, these poems show the supernatural side of Romanticism at its most powerful. A small book of some of the most unforgettable verse ever written.
whyReadIt: Coleridge's spellbinding, haunted ballad of the cursed sailor, with 'Kubla Khan' alongside. Unforgettable and strange.

funFacts.text: The albatross around the neck has become a common phrase for an inescapable burden.
